zh: 这台机器上没有这个终端程序
en: That shell is not on this machine

zh: 这是你自己的终端：以你的身份运行，不经过模型的权限和沙盒。模型看不到这里，除非你把内容发给它。
en: This is your own terminal: it runs as you, outside the model's permissions and sandbox. The model cannot see it unless you send it something.

zh: 这次会话改了哪些文件
这段排版没能显示，内容一字不少
en: This layout could not be shown; nothing is missing

zh: 连接一个模型服务，选好默认模型，就可以在项目里开始对话。
en: Connect a model service and pick a default model, then start a conversation in a project.

zh: 连接其他机器上的 Reasonix
en: Connect to Reasonix on other machines

zh: 连接异常，请检查网络或服务商
en: Connection failed; check network or provider

zh: 连接检测超时，请稍后重试
en: Connection check timed out; retry later

zh: 连接正常，模型调用未验证
连接跳转被拒绝，请检查地址
连接鉴权失败，请检查密钥或权限
en: Authentication failed; check key or permissions

zh: 连续多轮没有进展时暂停并提醒你
en: Pause and tell you when several rounds make no progress

zh: 选一家，填上 key 就能用。以后可以再加别的。
en: Pick one and fill in the key. You can add others later.

zh: 选择图标栏与侧栏工具卡片显示的入口和顺序
en: Choose the entries and order for the icon rail and sidebar tools card

zh: 重启后使用，不会自动重启。
en: Restart to use it; Studio never restarts by itself.

zh: 页面不在眼前，点选已取消
en: The page is not on screen, so picking was cancelled

zh: 页面已跳转或重新加载，点选已取消
en: The page navigated or reloaded, so picking was cancelled

zh: 页面里已经找不到这个元素
en: The element can no longer be found on the page

zh: 默认关闭。开启后，打开模型列表会使用已保存密钥检查已授权的全局连接和余额，不发送生成请求。
en: Off by default. When enabled, opening the model picker uses saved keys to check authorized global connections and balances, without generation requests.
